pages.text: Use the helm on a copper golem to make it a bronze golem, whatever its oxidation.

It stays within 32 blocks across and 8 up or down of the nearest [[bronze_chest]], and moves no items.

**Shift + right-click** with an empty hand to pack it up; use the item on a block to set it down.

A **bronze ingot** restores a quarter of its health.

Near an iron golem it now and then holds out a copper nugget.
